book_meta.work: The Seven Voyages of Sindbad, from ألف ليلة وليلة
book_meta.author: traditional

sentences.en: I climbed a tall tree to look around.
I saw a big white dome in the distance.

sentences.ar: مشيت لعندها وهي بلا باب ولا شباك.
sentences.en: I walked to it and it had no door and no window.
A huge bird was flying above me.
Its wings covered the whole sun.
Then I understood: the dome was an egg.
And the bird was called the roc.
